summary: Join our Circular Economy & Resource Management Training Course to learn innovative strategies for sustainability and effective resource use.
lede: Circular economy training helps sustainability, supply-chain and resource professionals shift operations toward material recovery and value retention. It addresses practical tasks such as mapping material flows, setting resource baselines and identifying waste, while developing skills in Material Flow Analysis and circularity measurement. Participants also explore product design for durability and disassembly, reverse logistics, and digital methods for tracking resources and reporting circularity.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals responsible for driving sustainability, optimizing supply chains, and managing resource efficiency within their organizations.
modules: Circular Economy Foundations and Value Retention
Circular Product Design and Lifecycle Assessment
Closed-Loop Supply Chains and Reverse Logistics
Circular Strategy Integration and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of their organization's supply chain, procurement, or sustainability operations. No prior technical expertise in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) or advanced environmental engineering is required, as practical tools and frameworks will be introduced progressively during the training. Participants are encouraged to bring high-level material flow or waste data from their own organizations to apply during the workshop exercises.
